summary: Tested the Book Purchase Link and Share Message Editor features. Backend: 12/12 pytest passed. GET /api/sharing is public and returns the defaults; PUT /api/admin/sharing returns 401 when unauthenticated and 403 for non-admins; it returns 422 for ftp:, javascript:, www.-without-scheme, URLs containing spaces, empty or whitespace-only subject, empty message and missing message; it trims whitespace, saves and persists. Frontend: all requested flows passed. The admin 'Edit Book & Sharing' link goes to /admin/sharing; saving shows a success toast and the values persist after reload; an invalid link shows the 422 error toast; a non-admin sees no link and is redirected to /dashboard. Welcome box 02 shows plain text with no link when book_url is blank, and a 'here' link (target=_blank, rel noopener) once it is set. /spread-the-word shows the message ending in 'Get the book: <url>' with no /register link; the mailto subject and body, the sms: link, the copy toast and the clipboard contents were all correct. Settings were restored to the defaults and the TEST users were deleted.

issues: The 'here' link is gold text on white, which is low contrast (about 2:1). Consider black or dark-gold text that keeps the underline.

action_items: Optional: improve the contrast of the gold welcome-book-link on the white box 02
critical_code_review_comments: /spread-the-word is not wrapped in guard(), so logged-out users can open it. This is harmless because GET /api/sharing is public, but confirm it is intended.
AdminSharing: api.get('/sharing') has no .catch, so a fetch failure leaves the Loader showing forever.

In the first combined UI run, one save with 'amazon.com/book' showed the success toast. An isolated rerun correctly sent that value, got a 422 and showed the error toast, so this was not reproducible and is probably a timing artefact of the test harness.
seed_data_creation: Used /app/backend/tests/seed_rep7_users.py seed/clean (TEST_free7, TEST_paid7 and the admin john.youell@newlifeokc.org, password Test1234!). All were cleaned up afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sharing settings live in db.settings _id='sharing'. Restore the defaults after testing (the pytest admin fixture does this automatically). Run the seed script first, then: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_lords_gym_sharing.py
